title: Fix TooltipTrigger asChild (nested button) + ThemeSwitcher hydration mismatch
body: strui TooltipTrigger destructures asChild but always renders a wrapper <button> around children -> <button><button> invalid HTML breaking hydration on DataStep (DatasetChip, quick-import) and SimpleTooltip. Add Slot-like asChild (cloneElement + merged event handlers/className/style/ref). ThemeProvider SSR always returns mode='dark' while client reads localStorage -> ThemeSwitcher hydration mismatch (IconMoon vs IconSun). Expose mounted from ThemeProvider, gate icon/aria/ring highlights on it.
